Case Study: Design and Development Support for Abbott’s Cardiovascular Division

Abbott’s Cardiovascular Division, a global leader in cardiac rhythm management, sought to enhance their design and development processes for their implantable stents and guidewires. With a focus on improving precision and compliance with evolving industry standards, Abbott required experienced mechanical engineers to support their R&D team. The project demanded expertise in designing high-precision mechanical parts, advanced 3D modeling, and knowledge of manufacturing processes using metals, plastics, and adhesives.

Viltis partnered with Abbott to deliver a tailored solution. We deployed a team of experienced engineers with specialized skills in 3D CAD software (SolidWorks 2021), Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T), and precision design. The team worked onsite at Abbott’s facility in Temecula, CA, ensuring seamless integration with their existing R&D group.

Our engineers focused on the following key areas:

Created and released high-precision drawings for mechanical components, ensuring tolerances were optimized for functionality and manufacturability.

Collaboration Across Disciplines:

Worked closely with electrical, firmware, and software engineers to ensure interdisciplinary alignment in product design.

Advanced Modeling and Drafting:

Utilized SolidWorks 2021 for 3D modeling, creating detailed drawings that adhered to GD&T standards.

Manufacturing Process Knowledge:

Applied expertise in various manufacturing processes, ensuring compatibility of designs with production requirements.

Regulatory Compliance:

Ensured that all designs met applicable industry standards and Abbott’s stringent quality guidelines.

Improved Design Efficiency:

Abbott’s R&D team experienced a significant reduction in design cycle times due to the expertise of the Viltis team.

Enhanced Product Precision:

The high-quality mechanical designs enabled improved functionality and reliability in Abbott’s cardiovascular products.

Seamless Integration:

By working onsite and fostering strong collaboration, our engineers effectively complemented Abbott’s internal resources.

The project not only addressed immediate design needs but also established improved processes for future product development.

Viltis successfully delivered a solution that enhanced Abbott’s design capabilities while maintaining their commitment to innovation and excellence. By aligning with their vision of restoring health and improving lives, we demonstrated our ability to support global healthcare leaders in achieving their goals.
